How The Numbers Are Calculated
A reference for every calculated figure in the app \u2014 what's included, what's excluded, and the exact formula. Click a (?) icon anywhere in the app to jump straight to that entry.
Business Intelligence
Business Overview
Included

Only orders with status Production Done or Delivered count toward Revenue and Production Cost — bucketed by Delivery Date (falling back to Production Done Date, then Ordered Date) landing inside the selected period.

Revenue

Sum of each completed order’s net value: (actual price × qty) across product lines, minus any refund, floored at ₹0.

Production Cost (COGS)

Frozen filament + machine cost from the moment the order was marked complete, plus packaging and delivery cost. Doesn’t drift if Settings rates change later.

Operating Exp. (OpEx)

Expenses tab entries dated in the period, excluding anything typed "Capex."

Net Profit / Margin

Net Profit = Revenue − COGS − OpEx. Margin % = Net Profit ÷ Revenue. Gross Margin % = (Revenue − COGS) ÷ Revenue.

Excluded

Quotes, Lost leads, Cancelled orders, and anything still Booked or In Production — their revenue/cost isn’t counted until marked complete. Capex is tracked separately and never reduces profit here.

Quote Pipeline
Scope

Every quote ever logged, across all time — not affected by the period filter at the top of the tab.

Conversion Rate

Converted ÷ (Converted + Lost) × 100. Shows — until at least one quote has been won or marked lost.

Order Pipeline
Scope

A live snapshot of every order’s current status right now — not filtered by the period picker. Quotes and Lost leads are excluded (they live in Quote Pipeline instead).

Overdue

Not yet complete, has a Due Date set, and that date has already passed.

Revenue Mix — D2C vs B2B
Scope

Same completed-order set and period as Business Overview.

B2B vs D2C

B2B = order is linked to a saved Client on the Orders tab. D2C = not linked. This is computed live off the link, not a stored flag — relinking an order reclassifies it immediately.

Margin & AOV by Client Type
Scope

Same completed orders as Business Overview, grouped by the linked client’s free-text "Type" field (Clients tab), case-insensitive.

Buckets

No linked client → "D2C / No Client." Linked client with no Type set → its own "B2B — Type Not Set" bucket, kept separate rather than merged.

Where The Money’s Going
Scope

Top 6 expense categories by spend in the Dashboard tab’s selected period, using the Category field on each logged expense. Uncategorized entries are grouped as "Uncategorized."

Note

Unlike the headline profit figures, this includes Capex — it’s a spend breakdown, not a profit calculation.

Dealer Performance Board
Scope

Same completed-order revenue as Business Overview, restricted to orders linked to a client, ranked by revenue within the selected period.

Tiers

If Dealer Rewards is enabled (Settings), each client’s tier is whichever configured threshold their period revenue has reached — the highest one that still qualifies. This is an informational ranking; the discount doesn’t auto-apply to invoices.

Client Order Trend
Scope

Completed (Production Done / Delivered) orders linked to whichever saved clients you pick, bucketed by the same date rule as Business Overview (Delivery Date, falling back to Production Done Date, then Ordered Date).

Metric

Order Count = number of completed orders in each period. Revenue = summed net order value (same figure used in Business Overview).

Range vs Period

This chart’s own Metric/Range/View controls are independent of the tab’s top-of-page period filter — pick clients, then compare them across time.

Cash Flow Timing
Collection Rate

Amount paid ÷ total order value for delivered orders in the selected period.

Avg Days to Full Payment

Average days between delivery date and last payment log entry, for orders marked fully Paid.

Outstanding > 30 Days

Delivered orders still unpaid or partially paid more than 30 days after delivery.

Revenue Concentration Risk
Top Client Share

Percentage of period revenue from the single largest client/source.

HHI

Herfindahl–Hirschman Index — sum of squared revenue shares. Above 2500 = highly concentrated (risky), 1500–2500 = moderate, below 1500 = diversified.

Order-to-Delivery Cycle Time
Formula

Delivery Date minus Ordered Date, in calendar days, for delivered orders in the period.

≤ 3 Day

Percentage of orders fulfilled in 3 days or fewer — a measure of fast-turnaround capability.

Reorder Rate & Frequency
Reorder Rate

Clients with 2+ completed orders ÷ total B2B clients (all time).

Avg Gap

Average number of days between consecutive completed orders for each client.

Cost Per Piece Trending
Formula

Total all-in cost (filament + machine + packaging + delivery) ÷ total pieces produced, per month.

Trend

A declining cost per piece over time indicates improving production efficiency or better bulk pricing.

Business Intelligence / Orders
Payments Outstanding
Included

Only Delivered orders that still have an amount due — across all time, not period-filtered. Booked, In Production, and Production Done orders are excluded until delivered.

Excluded

Orders marked fully Paid or Refunded, plus anything not yet Delivered (Booked, In Production, Production Done, Quoted, Lost, Cancelled).

Groups

Unpaid = nothing received yet. Partial = some payment logged, balance remains.

Business Intelligence / Expense Dashboard
Revenue vs Expenses
Formula

Same Revenue / COGS / OpEx rules as Business Overview, bucketed by month (or rolled up to quarter/year). Net = Revenue − (COGS + OpEx).

Range vs Period

This chart’s Range/View chips are independent of the tab’s top-of-page period filter — they control their own window.

Excluded

Capex, and any order not yet marked complete.

Channel Economics
Profit Per Hour by Channel
Formula

(Order Value − All-in Cost) ÷ Print Hours for completed orders, split by D2C vs B2B.

Use

Shows which channel earns more per hour of printer time — helpful for prioritizing when capacity is tight.

Revenue Per Printer Per Month
Formula

Total period revenue ÷ number of active printers (from Settings) ÷ months in period.

Note

Printer count is the current fleet size, not a historical average — best read alongside a stable fleet.

Avg Units Per Order by Channel
Formula

Total quantity (sum of product line qtys) ÷ number of completed orders, split by D2C vs B2B.

Client Lifetime Value (LTV)
Lifetime Value

Sum of net order value across all completed orders for each B2B client, all time.

Trajectory

Up = more than half of LTV came in the last 90 days. Steady = some recent activity. Down = no orders in the last 90 days.

Days Between Orders — Early Warning
Status

Compares how many days since their last order vs their historical average gap. Overdue = 2× their average, Late = 1.3×, On Track = within normal range.

Scope

Only clients with 2+ completed orders (need a pattern to measure against). All time.

Payment Behavior Score
Score

Paid orders earn 10 points, Partial earns 5, Unpaid earns 0. Normalized to 0–100.

Use

Identifies clients who consistently pay vs those who need follow-up or adjusted terms.

Operational Efficiency
Expense Ratio Trending
Formula

OpEx ÷ Revenue × 100 for each month. Only OpEx (not CapEx or raw materials) is included.

Health

Below 30% = healthy, 30–60% = watch, above 60% = high — you’re spending more than you should relative to revenue.

Breakeven Orders Per Month
Formula

Average monthly OpEx ÷ average profit per order. Result is the minimum orders needed each month to cover operating expenses.

Note

Uses period-filtered completed orders for profit, and all-time expense history for monthly OpEx average.

Projected Revenue from Open Pipeline
Pipeline Value

Sum of order values for all Booked, In Production, and Production Done orders.

Weighted Forecast

Booked at 50%, In Production at 80%, Production Done at 95% — a risk-adjusted projection of likely revenue.

Filament Burn Rate vs Purchase Frequency
Stock on Hand

Total spools from the Filament Inventory tab × spool size from Settings.

Avg Monthly Burn

Average grams used per month across all completed orders (all time).

Days of Stock Left

Current stock ÷ daily burn rate. Healthy = 60+ days, Low = 30–60, Critical = under 30.

Pricing Simulator
Pricing Simulator
COGS / Unit

Filament cost (weight × buffer × ₹/kg rate) + Machine cost (hours × buffer × machine rate). Uses material/color-specific rates from Filament Inventory when available.

All-In Cost

COGS + packaging per unit + delivery cost spread across quantity.

Margin Bar

Visual split of revenue into cost vs profit portions.

Pricing Scenarios

Shows the selling price needed to hit each margin target (breakeven, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%). Green border = your current margin falls in that range.

Margin vs Quantity

Bar chart showing how total profit changes with order size. Delivery cost is fixed, so larger orders spread it thinner and improve margin.

Saved Simulations

Click Save to store a scenario for later comparison. Stored in your browser alongside all other app data.

Production Scheduler
Production Scheduler
Active Orders

Orders with status Booked or In Production that still have print hours remaining.

Hours Queued

Total print hours across all active orders, including the failure/waste buffer from Settings.

Capacity Utilization

Bar chart showing print-hours loaded per day over the next 14 days. Red bar = capacity line (all running printers × hours/day). Orders are scheduled serially in priority order.

Order Timeline

Gantt chart showing when each order starts and finishes. Red bar = order won’t finish before its due date. Amber vertical line = due date marker.

Printer Load

Hours distributed evenly across running printers. Shows how many days of work each printer has.

What-If

Enter hypothetical print hours and a deadline. The scheduler checks whether your fleet can absorb it alongside existing work, and suggests how many dedicated printers you’d need if the shared pool can’t make it.

Expense Dashboard
Monthly Spend, Cumulative Burn & Growth Rate
Monthly Spend

Sum of every logged expense (Capex + OpEx) dated in that month.

Cumulative

Running total across all months shown in the current Range.

MoM Growth

(This month − Last month) ÷ Last month × 100. Left blank (—) when the prior month had ₹0 spend, since growth off a zero base isn’t a meaningful percentage.

CapEx vs OpEx Split
Formula

Same expenses as Monthly Spend, split by the Type field on each entry — Capex vs everything else (Opex) — for the selected period only.

Category Spend by Month
Scope

Same as "Where The Money’s Going," broken out by month instead of one period total, and showing every category (not just the top 6).

Top Vendors & Suppliers
Grouping

By the Vendor field logged directly on each expense — not guessed from the item description. Entries with no vendor set fall into "Unspecified."

Production Dashboard
Print Production Overview
Scope

Filament Used, Print Hours, and Material Cost come from every order with any produced hours/grams in the selected period — bucketed the same way as Revenue — regardless of the order’s current status. A still-Booked or In-Production order counts here as soon as some pieces are marked "Already made."

Fleet Utilization
Utilization %

Hours actually produced in the period ÷ theoretical fleet capacity (running printers × Hours/printer/day from Settings × days in the period). A month/year still in progress is capped at today, not its full length.

Busy / Idle / Down

A live snapshot of today’s printer state — not affected by the period filter. Busy = printers currently needed for the active queue (dedicated reserved lanes, plus the shared pool whenever anything’s waiting on it). Down = printers marked Down in Settings.

Buffer & Failure-Margin Impact
Formula

Extra Hours/Filament/Cost = buffered requirement − raw (unbuffered) requirement, for pieces actually made (or the whole order if complete) in the period, using the Failure Buffer % set in Settings.

Note

The line below the figures shows what Fleet Utilization would read without the buffer inflating "hours produced."

Print Success Rate
Source

The "Already made" and "Failed" fields logged on each order’s product lines — not period-filtered, all-time.

Grouped views

By Product / By Color only list entries with at least 2 attempts and at least 1 failure — a single clean success or one-off failure isn’t treated as a pattern yet.

Chronic badge

Shown when a product/color’s failure rate is at or above the app’s chronic threshold.

Filament Stock Health
Needed vs Have

Same have-vs-need math as the Filament Inventory tab’s Requirements table — grams booked-but-not-yet-made, by color, compared to grams on hand.

Below Par

A separate, independent check: fires whenever spools on hand for a color drop under that color’s own Reorder Point (set per-item on the Filament Inventory tab) — even if nothing is currently booked in that color, so a color can be flagged low before an order finds it empty.

Expenses Tab
Expense Summary
Scope

Total Spend, Capex, Opex, This Month, and the category bars are all-time totals across every logged expense — not affected by any period filter (those only apply on the Dashboard / Expense Dashboard tabs).
